brief:
Gaza's Government Media Office accused Israel of violating ceasefire commitments, Middle East Eye reported, saying the breaches have worsened the humanitarian crisis. Officials warned of an imminent "humanitarian catastrophe" as winter approaches, citing ongoing violations of the agreement's terms.

The accusation centers on Israel's failure to uphold pledges made under the Gaza ceasefire accord. Gaza officials did not detail specific violations in the available reporting.
